popularityEvidence.scope: Observed official pages substantiate popularity among discovered tornado/weather projects; not an exhaustive proof of every Minecraft project.

existingCoro.dependencyAlreadyAddedToModified: NEW remains NEW; not a BASE update

nativeRenderSite.nearbyEmbeddium: Redirect inside renderSnowAndRain to Minecraft.useFancyGraphics, distinct call site
nativeRenderSite.nearbyMekalus: Inject/ModifyArg on renderSnowAndRain body and weather pipeline, distinct call site in inspected annotations

permissionsAndWorldChanges.reviewedAgainst: Actual release JAR CFR decompilation and version2.8.3 official source; source alone is not runtime proof.

tornadoRip.nativeGate: strength/list/refined author rules and damage-deflector cache; optional cancellable Forge BreakEvent with fixed author fake player only when blockBreakingInvokesCancellableEvent=true
tornadoRip.delayedMutation: AIR or DIRT snapshots applied by Level.setBlock(...,3) every40ticks; claim/permission is not rechecked at queue application
tornadoRip.owner: Storm.spawnerUUID/playerControlled only supplies entity-grab exemptions; no demonstrated caster/claim permission gate
tornadoRip.inventoryBoundary: No blanket block-entity/inventory guard; author excludes normal chest and jukebox in strength safetyCheck, not every modded container; normal native block-removal side effects remain possible. No separate direct inventory-clear loop identified in reviewed release.

permissionsAndWorldChanges.firenado: TornadoHelper.tick directly sets FIRE above suitable ground; separate path from canGrabEventCheck.
permissionsAndWorldChanges.snowAndSand: WeatherObjectParticleStorm.tick -> WeatherUtilBlock.fillAgainstWallSmoothly -> trySpreadOnPos2 clears soft obstructions with AIR and adds layered blocks with setBlockAndUpdate; no FTB claim/direct Forge placement gate identified.
permissionsAndWorldChanges.lightning: Registered LightningBoltWeatherNew powers rods/changes copper via native calls. spawnFire/thunderHit call sites in its tick are commented out in this release; do not claim those inactive paths cause damage. Other generic storm/entity/wind paths remain author behavior.
permissionsAndWorldChanges.operatorCommands: /weather2 summon and other mutations require permission level2; autonomous storms do not have an authorized player caster.
permissionsAndWorldChanges.reasonNoOwnSafetyModule: User forbids own Safety/framework. This addition preserves author mechanics and defaults; no claim-protection guarantee is supplied and no hidden global griefing policy is introduced.
permissionsAndWorldChanges.nativeProtectionLimits: Author Weather Deflector is an in-world storm mechanism, not FTB claim integration; optional Forge BreakEvent does not by itself prove all delayed/fire/layer-placement paths protected.

renderingLimits.authorReported: Since2.7.7 supports Optifine/Rubidium shaders; author notes Oculus changes a fog path so snowstorm visuals can differ. Mekalus is Oculus fork. No extra shader mod or quality/distance settings changed.

textureStaticInventory.scope: PNG dimensions only, not stitcher/backend/GPU compatibility.
